artifacts.summary: 8-phase plan porting hard-mode churn/burnout counters, the cycle budget, and the drift/blocker auxiliary dispatches into the batch engine, plus a feature-flagged batch-of-one route for a single task number.

memory_candidates.content: In this repo's script-composed /orchestrate engine, a shell script never invokes the Agent tool -- only the lead does. So any single-task stage that both DETECTED a condition and DISPATCHED an agent inline (Stage 5b's three-strikes divergence audit, Stage 6's blocker-escalation fork, Stage 5a's drift-inspection fork) ports in two halves: the detecting script returns a REQUEST ({audit_requested, target, verbatim_goal}) which postflight persists as an aux_pending entry, and the NEXT cycle's orchestrate-cycle-plan.sh turns it into a dispatch row. Such rows belong in a sibling aux_dispatch[] array, never in dispatch[] -- widening dispatch[]'s phase vocabulary would break orchestrate-cycle-postflight.sh's --phase contract (phase-count corroboration, artifact-round advance) and risks silently routing a fixed-agent (fork/reviser-agent) dispatch through command-route-agent.sh's task-type resolution.
